links.outcome: Proportion of LLM responses without major error or potential harm on HPV questions
links.effect: 42/45 (93.3%) ChatGPT and 38/45 (84.4%) DeepSeek-V3 responses had no major error or potential harm; exploratory question-level risks in HPV16/18 positivity, normal cytology, partner management, pregnancy.
links.quote: Responses without major error or potential harm occurred in 42/45 (93.3%; 95% CI, 81.7-98.6%) ChatGPT responses and 38/45 (84.4%; 70.5-93.5%) DeepSeek-V3 responses (risk difference, 8.9 percentage points; 95% CI, -13.3 to 31.1; p = 0.344).

screen.reason: The study evaluates and compares LLM-generated responses (ChatGPT and DeepSeek) to HPV-related patient questions using expert ratings for safety, accuracy, and guideline concordance. It tests the models offline and does not evaluate a specific deployment safeguard practice.
